changeSet.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS unaccent; CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm;

changeSet.author: GA-Lotse
changeSet.sql: -- The unaccent function is not immutable, since the dictionary is dynamically loaded and can be changed between deployments. -- To properly use this for indexing in postgres, we have to create an immutable wrapper function. -- If the dictionary *is* changed, the index should be recreated to avoid unexpected issues. CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION normalize_text(input text) RETURNS text AS $body$ select public.unaccent(regdictionary 'public.unaccent', $1) $body$ LANGUAGE SQL IMMUTABLE;
